records.title: Student Health Services
records.text: Student Health Services provides acute medical care to currently enrolled McNeese students. Treatment has no charge at the time of service, except that laboratory work or X-rays may be billed. Services include care for respiratory or throat infections, minor first aid, vomiting or fever, blood-pressure checks, urinary tract infections, ear infections, skin infections or rashes, and muscle strains or sprains. Location: 4100 Ryan St., Lake Charles, LA 70601. Contact: 337-475-5748 or studenthealth@mcneese.edu. Clinic hours and appointments: Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Friday 7:30 a.m.-11:30 a.m. The clinic is closed on university holidays. In an emergency, call University Police at 337-475-5711, call 911, or go to the nearest emergency room.

records.title: Find Your Academic Advisor
records.text: To find your assigned academic advisor: 1. Go to https://my.mcneese.edu/, select Banner 9, and sign in with your credentials. 2. Select the STUDENTS tab. 3. Select STUDENT PROFILE. 4. Your academic advisor is listed at the bottom of the page. The public advising page lists the McNeese contact number 800-622-3352 for access assistance.

records.title: University ID Cards
records.text: Students can request a McNeese ID card with the Student ID Card Form on the official University ID Cards page and pick it up at the University Police office. The initial card is free; replacement cards have a $10 charge. University Police is at 4497 Dr. Philip Williams Dr. Contact University Police at 337-562-4911 or mcneesepd@mcneese.edu. The form requires the student's name, birthday, McNeese email address, Banner ID number, classification, and an acceptable photo upload.

records.title: Current International Students
records.text: Current international students should use the International Student Services online guide for visa-status and I-20 questions and contact International Student Services before an I-20 expires. The office phone is 337-475-5243 and the published contacts are internationaloffice@mcneese.edu and intinfo@mcneese.edu. The guide covers visa status, CPT and OPT, and current-student FAQs. This is immigration-status guidance, so the student should obtain a case-specific decision from International Student Services rather than relying on an academic-standing or financial-aid page.

records.title: Parking Citation Appeals
records.text: A parking or traffic citation appeal must be filed online with the Traffic e-Appeal form within 7 calendar days of the citation date. All fields must be completed. The outcome is sent by email, and the appeal committee's decision is final. University Police contact: 337-475-5711, mcneesepd@mcneese.edu, 4497 Dr. Philip Williams Dr.

records.title: Office of the Registrar
records.text: The Office of the Registrar is part of Student Central at 4435 Ryan Street, Lake Charles, LA 70605. Contact: 337-475-5065. Regular office hours: Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Friday 7:30 a.m.-11:30 a.m. Published regular hours may be superseded by university holidays, emergency closures, or dated notices on the official page.

records.title: Class Listings Information
records.text: For an unresolved class-time conflict, compare available sections in the official Class Search and contact the academic advisor or Student Central before changing registration. Options supported by the schedule are to choose a different non-conflicting section or drop/change a course within the published term deadlines. Student Central contact: 337-475-5065. AskMcNeese can compare published section meeting times and prepare a conflict-checked Class Planner schedule, but it does not register the student in Banner or promise an override.
